name: Rhodesia

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, white and green, with the Rhodesian coat of arms in the center of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: The coat of arms shows a gold pick on a green shield, for mining, and is topped by the Zimbabwe Bird, a carving found at Great Zimbabwe.

hook: Rhodesia, the white-minority state declared in 1965, flew green-white-green vertical stripes with a coat of arms in the center; Nigeria's green-white-green is plain.
trivia: Rhodesia's 1965 Unilateral Declaration of Independence from Britain was not formally recognized by any country.
The flag was first raised on 11 November 1968, the third anniversary of the declaration, replacing a blue ensign with the Union Jack.
